Translation: And We appointed for Moses thirty nights
And We completed them with ten
So the time appointed by his Lord was completed as forty nights

Arabic text: وَقَالَ مُوْسَى لِأَخِيْهِ هَارُوْنَ اخْلُفْنِيْ فِيْ قَوْمِيْ
Translation: And Moses said to his brother Aaron: "Take my place among my people
And act rightly, and do not follow the way of the mischief-makers"
